verdict.rationale: Proton Pass generates TOTP codes inside saved login items (docs-5), and the export options, including a PGP-encrypted ZIP (docs-4, docs-11), give a documented backup path. Vault items are also reachable from other clients such as the desktop app and the CLI (docs-9, docs-14), so tokens are not tied to one phone. However, no evidence explicitly walks through restoring tokens on a new device after losing a phone. Missing for 10: an explicit documented lost-device recovery flow, explicit confirmation that TOTP secrets sync across devices, and hands-on or community corroboration of restoring tokens on a new phone.
